name: HT-51 - Publicar reporte.creado (pegar en UrbanPulse - Central)

parameters.query:
SELECT
    gen_random_uuid()::TEXT AS evento_id,
    to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS fecha,
    r.id::TEXT AS reporte_id,
    COALESCE(distrito_de_reporte(r.id), 'DESCONOCIDO') AS distrito,
    CASE
        WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM r.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Lima') BETWEEN 6 AND 11 THEN 'manana'
        WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM r.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Lima') BETWEEN 12 AND 17 THEN 'tarde'
        ELSE 'noche'
    END AS franja,
    COALESCE(r.incident_type, 'otro') AS tipo_incidente
FROM reports AS r
WHERE r.id = $1::UUID;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { id: $json.evento_id, tipo: 'reporte.creado', fecha: $json.fecha, origen: 'n8n/central', datos: { reporte_id: $json.reporte_id, distrito: $json.distrito, franja: $json.franja, tipo_incidente: $json.tipo_incidente } } }}
